channel.title: CoffeeLovesTea Music
channel.description: The latest songs from the CoffeeLovesTea radio station — Bean the black bear at the turntables, spinning football-season favorites, cozy fall songs, horror after dark, and gentle dreamscape instrumentals. The station is always free to listen.

item.title: New song: “First Date”
item.description: The newest song to join the CoffeeLovesTea radio station. Settle in with a warm cup and press play — the station is always free.

item.title: New song: “Dread” — horror after dark
item.description: “Dread” joins the after-dark lineup on the free CoffeeLovesTea radio station — a horror song for spooky nights, with the lyrics shown word by word as they are sung.

item.title: Coming in December: the Thriller Collection
item.description: Ten psychological thriller songs are headed to the free CoffeeLovesTea radio station this December: Who's in My House, Inside My Head Tonight, Who's Calling Me, Psychological Thriller, There's a Stranger in Our House, Who's in My House (Part 2), The Police Are There, Coffeehouse Thriller, The Mirror Lied, and The Last Customer.

item.title: Football Sundays: “Cold Sweet Tea-n-Football”
item.description: Our football-season favorite now plays in the Sunday 10–11 slot on the free CoffeeLovesTea radio station — cold sweet tea, game day, and Bean at the turntables.

item.title: Spooky season: “Witch's Brew”
item.description: “Witch's Brew” is stirring on the free CoffeeLovesTea radio station — a spooky-season song for the horror-after-dark hours.

item.title: Dreamscape: “Moonlight Through a Quiet Window”
item.description: A gentle light-classical instrumental for winding down — soft piano and strings under a starry sky, from the station's dreamscape sleep music. Free to listen, all night long.

item.title: Dreamscape, redone: “Rain on the Window”
item.description: “Rain on the Window” has been remade as a tender light-classical instrumental — part of the station's rain series at light, medium, and heavy intensities. Free to listen on CoffeeLovesTea radio.
